preconditions.description: Input dimensions r and c are integers between 1 and 500 inclusive.
Input consists of exactly two space-separated integers r and c.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '0' if (r == 1 and c == 1) else True
postconditions.description: If r = 1 and c = 1, output is 0 (no solution exists).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for row in stdout.strip().split('\n') for num in row.split()) if stdout.strip() != '0' else True
postconditions.description: Each matrix element is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().split('\n')) == r if stdout.strip() != '0' else True
postconditions.description: Output contains exactly r rows if a solution exists.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row.split()) == c for row in stdout.strip().split('\n')) if stdout.strip() != '0' else True
postconditions.description: Each row contains exactly c space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: len(set(b)) == r + c if stdout.strip() != '0' else True
postconditions.description: All row and column GCDs (b) are pairwise distinct (diverse matrix).

postconditions.expression: max(b) == min(max(b) for matrix in possible_matrices(r, c) if is_diverse(matrix)) if stdout.strip() != '0' else True
postconditions.description: The magnitude (max of b) is minimized among all possible diverse matrices.
